title: SAILCOMPASS: Towards Reproducible and Robust Evaluation for Southeast Asian Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance using English prompts versus native Southeast Asian language prompts, and measuring performance disparities between English-to-target and target-to-English translation directions.
Calculating the standard deviation of recall across multiple-choice option identifiers (e.g., A, B, C, D) to measure if the language model disproportionately favors predicting specific token IDs.

Measuring the relative length discrepancy between model predictions and reference options to evaluate whether the model has a surface form bias that overestimates or underestimates based on option text length.

Analyzing class prediction imbalances in natural language inference and sentiment classification tasks, and estimating prior token biases (e.g., majority label bias, recency bias) using context-free test inputs before applying contextual calibration.
